extraction.document_summary: This document is a marketing-only brochure for Great Eastern’s “Critical Cover Series” critical illness insurance. It positions the product as coverage that can pay again after a first critical illness claim (“continues over and over again, beyond your first claim”). The brochure explains the rationale: some critical illnesses can recur and increase the risk of a second or even a third critical illness, so the policy is meant to provide repeated protection. However, it does not state any specific list of covered critical illnesses, claim triggers, payout amounts, limits, waiting periods, renewal/coverage term mechanics, or underwriting requirements. It also states that the product has no savings or investment feature and there is no cash value if the policy ends or is terminated prematurely.
quality_notes: The brochure text provided is largely promotional and does not include the critical illnesses covered, payout amounts, or any concrete claim/limit mechanics.
No plan names/options, ward classes, ages/terms for entry/coverage, underwriting type, or premium-payment details are stated in the provided text.
The only actionable product description is that it is critical illness coverage designed to pay repeatedly beyond the first claim.

policies.quick_summary: Great Eastern’s “GREAT Critical Cover Series” is critical illness insurance marketed to provide repeated protection beyond the first claim. The brochure frames the product around recurrence risk and the possibility of a second or third critical illness claim. It explicitly states the product has no savings or investment feature and therefore provides no cash value if the policy ends or is terminated prematurely. Specific covered conditions, claim triggers, payout amounts, limits, waiting periods, and entry/coverage terms are not provided in the supplied brochure text, so only the high-level “claim again” concept can be extracted.

important_caveats: This is an advertisement and not a contract; precise terms are specified in the policy contract.
All ages specified refer to age next birthday.

source_evidence.quote:
Critical Cover Series
Critical illness coverage that continues
over and over again, beyond your first claim

When a critical illness strikes, it doesn't just impact your health 1 you also need to think
about how the costs of managing the condition will affect your family's finances.
And because some critical illnesses can recur and increase your risk of developing a second
or even a third critical illness, it's important to be ready for whatever might come your way.

As this product has no savings or investment feature, there is no cash value if the policy ends or is terminated
prematurely.
All ages specified refer to age next birthday.

The above is for general information only. It is not a contract of insurance. The precise terms and conditions of this
insurance plan are specified in the policy contract.
